ALTER PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS_TRU] AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus
AS(
SELECT
BTP.PORTFOLIO_NO AS CustomerAccountId,
BTP.AUTH_DATE AS PeriodStartTimestamp,
NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp,
BTP.STATUS AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,
'TRU' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE,
BTP.INSERT_DTTM,
BTP.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId


FROM BUSC.TRU_PORTFOLIO BTP
where BTP.ISLATEST = '1'
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus;

-- CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_SRC
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)  
,convert(varchar, CustomerAccountStatusTypeId) 
,convert(varchar, FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW,  CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus 
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT
AS(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
convert(varchar,CustomerAccountId)  
,convert(varchar, CustomerAccountStatusTypeId) 
,convert(varchar, FinancialInstitutionId)
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus
WHERE (PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
OR PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01' )
AND SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'
),

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA
AS(
SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR,
    TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR,
    ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId,
    ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId,TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId,
    ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode,
    CASE
        WHEN TGT.HASHROW  IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
        WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS


FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_TGT TGT
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
and SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA;

--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM
UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
and  DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode 
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC 
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
and SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId 
AND SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId = TGT.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId 
WHERE (TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL 
OR TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp = '1900-01-01' )
AND TGT.SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'


--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountStatus
(CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,CustomerAccountStatusNote
,SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,WORKFLOWID
,TASKRUNID
,INSERTDTTM)

SELECT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId 
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,NULL AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,SRC.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,NULL AS CustomerAccountStatusNote
,'TRU' AS SOURCESYSTEMCODE
,SRC.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AS FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID
,0 AS WORKFLOWID
,0 AS TASKRUNID
,SRC.INSERT_DTTM AS INSERTDTTM
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA DELTA 
 ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
   AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
    AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode
 WHERE RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountStatus_DELTA;

END
GO
